evidence: Manual application of the check-probe-not-in-seed procedure (the private checker was not executed; this is a source review, not a portal checker run). (1) Probe inventory: the only literal value a criterion tells the judge to create is the polish note 'Call back on Fri' (tests/scored/polish/judge.toml, first criterion). Every other created value is judge-chosen and explicitly required to be unique: functional prompt.md 'open a new job ... with a unique title (add a short suffix for this review) ... one candidate ... unique name and email' and 'Use your own new jobs and cards for every board protocol (suffix every title and name for this review), never move another review's records, and never rely on starting counts'; constraints judge.toml 'a unique title ... a unique name, a unique email address'; polish 'distinctive reply'/'distinctive unsent reply'. Letter labels J1/J2, A-F, V-Z are scenario handles under the suffix rule. (2) Seed check: grep of environment/assets/seed_data.json, solution seed (byte-identical), index.html, js/*.js and bootstrap.js for 'call back', 'Fri', 'J1', 'J2', 'J3', 'probe', 'JUDGE' returned no hits. Seed jobs are Platform Engineer, Data Analyst, Product Designer; 16 application names/emails, 3 notes ('Strong systems answers...', 'References checked...', 'Portfolio is concept work only.') contain none of the probes. Seed has no activity collection and no drafts, so no Activity line, note draft or reply draft is pre-present. (3) The one fixed seeded identity used as a mutation probe, tomas.varga@candidates.example in hro_candidate_linked, is already on seeded APP-201 (Data Analyst), but the criterion grades the card added to the review's own suffixed J2 becoming Tomas's application, distinguishable by job title from the seeded Data Analyst one, and the protocol guards a collision ('if that address is already on J2, open a new job J3 for it'). (4) Cross-dimension leftovers that could pre-satisfy a draft probe are handled: polish prompt 'If a message or note box already holds text from an earlier review, record it and clear it before typing your own'; golden drafts are per-user localStorage (app.js:38-43) and each dimension's Playwright MCP is --isolated. (5) Seeded expectations (Lena's 1 unread from reads read_count 2 of 3 APP-301 messages, Noor's 120 messages) are read-only baselines, not created probes, so they are outside this row. Broken-app attempt: an app that renders seed data only, or replays seeded activity/notes, cannot show a suffixed job, suffixed candidates, 'Call back on Fri', or a new J2 application for Tomas, so it cannot pre-satisfy any mutation probe. Conforming-alternative attempt: an app that stores drafts server-side could carry a functional-review draft into polish, but the polish clear-first instruction prevents a false pass or false fail; functional hro_drafts uses Tomas's brand-new J2 conversation. No pre-satisfied probe found.
